issues: 没有导出时长，工作台从源码抓到 34f，只渲出前两张卡起身，回弹与场景回正都看不到
书页底板是灰条骨架壳（灰侧栏条、灰顶栏条），平灰 #dddddb 底没有任何桌面/纸张感
近排立墙后两侧卡片出画，左侧露出半截黑色侧栏楔形
卡片立起后像贴图：卡位处没有留下任何痕迹，根部只有一团模糊阴影，卡面明暗不随角度变化
changes: 补导出 POPUP_BOOK_RISE_DURATION=160（108f 回正后静止 52f，md 的 4–5.5s 内）
底板换成完整 FakeDashboard(A)（侧栏/顶栏真实内容），卡位处是模切留下的浅凹槽（内阴影），卡立起后露出；背景换暖调纸面桌 + 纸纤维颗粒 + 暖色暗角，与 masking-tape-slap 同材料语言
整页缩到 0.8，近排立墙后左右都留在画内
根部投影改为两层（随立起收窄的软影 + 立直后出现的贴地接触线）；立起的卡面靠铰链底部加随角度出现的环境遮蔽，立起中段有一次上亮下暗的受光变化
立起 spring（damping 11，过冲到 −95° 回 −90°）、远排先近排后 7f 错峰与 75°→68° 回正全部保留
issuesEn: No duration export, so the workbench grabbed 34f from the source and rendered only the first two cards starting to rise; the rebound and scene settle never appeared
The page base was a grey skeleton shell (grey sidebar and top-bar bars) on a flat #dddddb background with no sense of desk or paper
After the near row stood up, the side cards left the frame and half a black sidebar wedge showed on the left
Risen cards read as decals: nothing was left in their slots, the root was one blurry shadow, and face shading never changed with angle
changesEn: Added POPUP_BOOK_RISE_DURATION=160 (52f hold after the 108f settle, within the md's 4–5.5s)

The base is the full FakeDashboard(A) with real sidebar/top-bar content, and each slot is a shallow die-cut recess with an inner shadow revealed as its card rises; the background is a warm paper desk with fiber grain and warm vignette, matching masking-tape-slap
The whole page is scaled to 0.8 so the standing near row stays inside the frame

Root shadow is two layers (a soft shadow that narrows as the card rises plus a contact line once upright); risen faces get angle-driven occlusion near the hinge and one top-lit/bottom-shaded pass mid-rise
The rise spring (damping 11, overshoot to −95° back to −90°), far-row-first 7f stagger and 75°→68° settle are unchanged
